WeaponPerks.Name: Headseeker
WeaponPerks.Description:
Upon dealing direct non-Precision Weapon Damage:
Grants increased Precision Damage and 3?% Increased Auto Aim Cone Size for 0.55 seconds. 
Dealing additional Non-Precision Damage refreshes the buff duration.
The perk actually multiplies the Precision Bonus by 1.2x, but the actual Precision Damage Increase results are easier to explain.

Precision Damage Increase per Intrinsic Frame:
Adaptive Pulse = 7.1% | Aggressive Pulse = 10% | Heavy Burst Pulse = 9.5%
High-Impact Pulse = 8.74% | Lightweight Pulse = 6.3% | Rapid-Fire Pulse = 10.3%
Adaptive Burst Sidearm = 8.46% | Heavy Burst Sidearm = 7.36%
Heavy Burst Hand Cannon = 7% increased Weakspot Damage.

↑Passively grants +5 Stability.

What even is a Weakspot? How is it different from a Precision Hit?
Weakspot Hits that do not register as a Precision Hit can still benefit or trigger Weakspot effects, such as Headseeker, or Heavy Burst Hand Cannon's intrinsic 9.5% Weakspot Damage Buff.
Similarly, Precision Hits are not always scored on Weakspots, and may not trigger Weakspot effects.
Currently, the existence of "Weakspot Modifiers" is a bug.

Damage instances within 0.2 seconds of each without missing increments a Magazine-capacity based counter towards a damage increase.

↑Damage Increase begins at 18.8% [12.54%] and ends at 45% [30%]. Results in a 28.3% [19.02%] Average Damage Increase over a full Magazine.

SeasonWeaponPerks.Description:
Upon finishing a reload within 5 seconds of a kill:
The impact from the first shot fired deals an additional instance of 230 ↑250 [10 ↑12] Weapon-Matching Splash Damage over ~2 meters, removing Combatant Shields on hit.
 Also removes Barrier Champion's Barrier Shield, even with a different Breaker Effect active. Ignores Bane Damage Resist. Does NOT remove Ablative Shields. 
Splash Damage is not affected by Weapon Damage Increases, Power Delta, or Combatant Scalars, but does count as Weapon Damage.
Buff persists through stow. Can be triggered multiple times from a single kill. Removes SOME immune shields :)

Picking up a Special/Power Ammo Bricks grants Kill Shot to all weapons with the mod equipped.

WeaponMods.Name: Synergy
WeaponMods.Description:
Scoring 12 ↑8 [6 ↑4?] Weapon Kills spawns a Weapon Element-Matching Subclass Pickup.
 Kinetic Weapons instead spawn an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Kill counter persists through stow.

Synergy ignores the global cooldown for Pickups, but will trigger the global cooldown upon spawning one.
Synergy has its own cooldown depending on the spawned Pickup:
Ionic Traces = 0 seconds
Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Stasis Shards = 5 seconds.
Tangles = 12 seconds
Can spawn 2 Pickups simultaneously if the 12th kill would also trigger a different Pickup spawner.

Kills during Synergy's cooldown do not contribute to the activation.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Balanced Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon beginning a Manual Vent while Heat is ≥875:
2x Vent Rate Multiplier.

Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 15% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon cancelling a Manual Vent while Heat is ≤125:
Dynamic Heat Limiter | -50% Heat Generation for 5 seconds or until stowing the weapon.
Triggering Dynamic Heat Limiter through reload or sprint after having dealt damage will freeze the timer until shooting.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 15% Increased Impact Damage to Rank-and-File, and 32.25% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.
Additionally, they deal 2.5% increased direct damage to Guardians.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Support Frame
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Shoots slow, tracking projectiles that travel at a speed of 40m/s. Projectiles do not have a distance limit, but will eventually lose their tracers.
 Has 50% Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance at 0 Range, down to 25% at 100 Range, compared to a regular Auto Rifle.

Dealing ANY (really, ANY!) damage generates Weapon Energy, at a rate of 1% Energy for every 4 [3.6] damage dealt, reaching 100% Charge after dealing 400 [360] damage.
Dealing damage with the Support Auto Rifle doubles the Weapon Energy gains, generating 1% Energy for every 2 [1.8] damage, requiring 200 [180] damage to fully charge.

Looking near an ally within range widens the reticle. Hipfiring while an ally is in healing range will shoot healing projectiles that have much stronger tracking.
Consumes 2% Weapon Energy per healing shot fired towards an ally, restoring 13.3 HP to them on impact.
Targeting Range = 28 + (0.1 x Range Stat) meters, up to 38 Meters at 100 Range.
If multiple allies are targeted, then the healing shots will alternate between allies.

Upon scoring 5 healing hits within 1 second of each on allies:
The next healing hits within 1 seconds of each on allies bestows them with an Element-Matching Effect, and applies Support Frame Boost to the user and the targeted ally.
Support Frame Boost grants 10% increased weapon damage for 6 seconds. Stacks with everything.
Strand Support Frames cause the targeted ally to release 4 Unraveling Projectiles.
Solar Support Frames bestow Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds to the targeted ally.
Void Support Frames bestow 15 Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds to the targeted ally. 

Only triggers On-Heal Effects upon applying Rapid Healing. Shots that restore missing health count for "on-hit" related interactions.
Incurs a 1.5 second cooldown upon applying Support Frame Boost before additional healing hits are counted on the same ally.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Support Frame
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Shoots slow, tracking projectiles that travel at a speed of 40m/s. Projectiles do not have a distance limit, but will eventually lose their tracers.
 Has 50% Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance at 0 Range, down to 25% at 100 Range, compared to a regular Auto Rifle.

Dealing ANY (really, ANY!) damage generates Weapon Energy, at a rate of 1% Energy for every 4 [3.6] damage dealt, reaching 100% Charge after dealing 400 [360] damage.
Dealing damage with the Support Auto Rifle doubles the Weapon Energy gains, generating 1% Energy for every 2 [1.8] damage, requiring 200 [180] damage to fully charge.

Looking near an ally within range widens the reticle. Hipfiring while an ally is in healing range will shoot healing projectiles that have much stronger tracking.
Consumes 2% Weapon Energy per healing shot fired towards an ally, restoring 13.3 HP to them on impact.
Targeting Range = 28 + (0.1 x Range Stat) meters, up to 38 Meters at 100 Range.
If multiple allies are targeted, then the healing shots will alternate between allies.

Upon scoring 5 healing hits within 1 second of each on allies:
The next healing hits within 1 seconds of each on allies bestows them with an Element-Matching Effect, and applies Support Frame Boost to the user and the targeted ally.
Support Frame Boost grants 10% increased weapon damage for 6 seconds. Stacks with everything.
Strand Support Frames cause the targeted ally to release 4 Unraveling Projectiles.
Solar Support Frames bestow Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds to the targeted ally.
Void Support Frames bestow 15 Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds to the targeted ally. 

Only triggers On-Heal Effects upon applying Rapid Healing. Shots that restore missing health count for "on-hit" related interactions.
Incurs a 1.5 second cooldown upon applying Support Frame Boost before additional healing hits are counted on the same ally.

Weapon Kills refill Sturm and grant it an Overcharged Bullet with increased damage, up to 25 Sturm Overcharge stacks.

Further Weapon Kills within ? seconds of the last grant 5 Sturm Overcharge stacks.

OriginTraits.Name: Willing Vessel
OriginTraits.Description:
Dealing damage or scoring kills increments a Damage based counter towards stat bonuses.
100% Counter is displayed as x5 Willing Vessel. Counter constantly decreases by 2.2?% every 1? seconds.

Visual Buff Stacks to Damage Thresholds:
Auto: ? | ? | ? | ? | ?
Bow: ~180 | ~750 | ? | ? | ?
Sidearm: ? | ? | ? | ? | ?
SMG : ? | ? | ? | ? | ?
Fusion Rifle: ? | ? | ? | ? | ?
Glaive: ? | ? | ? | ? | ?
GL: I | don't | think | so | lmao
LFR: ~380 | ~1750 | ~3450 | ~4150 | ~6200
MG: ~385 | ? | ? | ? | ?
Sword: ? | ? | ? | ? | ?

Grants a continuously increasing Stability, Handling, Reload Speed, and Charge Rate stat bonus as more damage/kills are scored.
Stat Bonuses (at the start of the stack):
x1 = +? Stability, +? Handling, +2? Reload Speed, 0.?x Draw/Charge Time Multiplier, and +20 Charge Rate
x2 = +? Stability, +? Handling, +5 Reload Speed, 0.?x Draw/Charge Time Multiplier, and +40 Charge Rate
x3 = +? Stability, +? Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.?x Draw/Charge Time Multiplier, and +50 Charge Rate
x4 = +? Stability, +? Handling, +25 Reload Speed, 0.?x Draw/Charge Time Multiplier, and +70 Charge Rate
x5 = +20? Stability, +30? Handling, +30 Reload Speed, 0.85x Draw/Charge Time Multiplier, and +80 Charge Rate

This is basically Target Lock's S Curve mixed with Field-Tested on top of being actually damage based, so it is much harder to test, sorry!

ArcVerbs.Name: Bolt Charge
ArcVerbs.Description:
Damage instances scored within 3 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active increments a Magazine-capacity based counter towards gaining a stack of Bolt Charge.
Grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, up to 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Gaining a stack through damage prevents simultaneous damage instances from incrementing the counter.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 2
Area-Denial GLs: 3 or 4?
Swords: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1
Glaive Melee, as well as Damage-over-Time sources all count.

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Floor Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Floor Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Glaive Melee | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

SolarVerbs.Name: Restoration
SolarVerbs.Description:
Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s
Healing Effect does not stack with Healing Rift.

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.
If the new duration is longer than the previous longest, the new duration is used instead.
Eg: If the maximum Restoration duration achieved was 15 seconds, a Phoenix Dive or Healing Grenade will refresh it to 15 seconds.

Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

SolarVerbs.Name:
Solar Effect
Damage Scaling
SolarVerbs.Description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Applying a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as Radiant, Solar Weapon Surges, and Overcharge.

Applying Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

Damage Resistance: 90% [~50?%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second.

Song of Flame:
Caster is granted +100 Grenade, +100 Melee, +100 Class, Radiant and Scorching Rounds. 
Weapon Kills by the Caster count as Super Kills. Weapon damage does not count as Ability damage.
Allies within 15 metres are granted 30% [?%] Damage Resist, Scorching Rounds, and 15% Fixed Bonus Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per second.
Grants full Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Scorching Rounds:
Dealing Kinetic or Solar Weapon Damage inflicts Scorch, with the stack amount and cooldown between Scorch applications varying per Weapon Type.
x3+2 Scorch every 0.2 seconds = Auto Rifles | Submachine Guns
x5+5 Scorch every 0.2? seconds = Machine Guns | Trace Rifles
x10+5 Scorch every 0.6 seconds = Hand Cannon | Pulse Rifle | Scout Rifles | Sidearms
x15+5 Scorch every 0.4 seconds = Fusion Rifles (+Bastion) | Glaive (Melee/Projectile) | Shotgun | Sniper Rifle | Swords (+Solar Ergo Sum)
x20+10 Scorch every 0.6? seconds = Bows | Heavy Grenade Launchers | Special Grenade Launchers | Linear Fusion Rifles (+Arbalest) | Rocket Launchers
Double Fire Grenade Launchers can inflict x40+x20 Scorch in a single shot.

Grenade Ability: Drains 4.8% Super Energy, and has a 2 second cooldown between usages.
Sends forth a homing Solar Wisp that detonates on impact, dealing up to 685 [?] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. Wisps have ? HP.
Another Wisp is spawned on the impact location if an enemy is within 15? meters, chasing towards the closest enemy it hasn't already damaged.
Can spawn up to 3 additional Wisps per ability usage.
Consuming a Solar Wisp while Heat Rises is equipped grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Melee Ability: Drains 2.4% Super Energy, and has a 1.75 second cooldown between usages.
Celestial Fire sends out 5 Solar blasts, each dealing up to 200 [87] damage and inflicting x10+5 Scorch.
Incinerator Snap releases a barrage of 7 Solar Sparks, each dealing up to 155 [41] damage and inflicting x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch.
[Auto Melee] against an enemy within Melee Lunge Distance while Incinerator Snap is equipped performs an Enhanced Basic Melee that deals 1000 [456] Solar Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over a tiny radius, consuming Super Energy and a Melee Ability Charge.

Class Ability: Drains 6% Super Energy, and has a 2.85 second cooldown between usages.
Functions as the selected Class Ability, recharging quickly at the cost of Super Energy.

VoidVerbs.Name: Invisibility
VoidVerbs.Description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility

ExoticWeapons.Name: Alethonym
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Stasis Micro-Missile Grenade Launcher Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)

Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 534 [91] Explosive Damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, receiving 113 Stasis Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds. 
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.

Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.

Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and cannot impale Combatants.

Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the One For All trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Barrow-Dyad
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Strand Aggressive Submachine Gun
Behaves differently depending on the current Path.

Automatically refills magazine-based Ammo every 0.2 seconds while not firing, refilling up to 34 Ammo over 4.85 seconds.
1-2 Ammo = 4 Refill per tick | 3-8 Ammo = 3 Refill | 9-16 Ammo = 2 Refill | 17 or higher = 1 Refill
Firing delays refilling to 0.285 seconds. Can fire permanently at 1 Ammo at 240?RPM. Refills to 34 Ammo to not prevent reloading.

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers. 
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 160 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within ? seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 41 [9?] Impact Damage and up to 499 [21?] Explosive Damage.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:
Panic Response I–V
Taken Divergence
↑Craftable Trait

+100 Reload Speed and 0.7x Draw Time Multiplier for ? seconds.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Coldheart
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Adaptive Trace Rifle

Steadily grants up to 80% increased damage as Energy is accumulated.

Upon dealing damage:
Charges up 40% Energy/s for 1 second. 
Initial Charge has a 0.267 second delay before it starts incrementing. Not generating Energy for 1.05 seconds will remove all Energy over 0.2 seconds.

Upon picking up an Ionic Trace:
Slowly grants 50% Energy over 0.5 seconds.

While in the maximum damage state:
+100 Stability and +100 Reload Speed.
Hits spawn an Ionic Trace, with a 2 second cooldown.

↑Catalyst
Passively grants +20 Stability and +20 Reload Speed.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Collective Obligation
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Void Adaptive Pulse Rifle

Scoring 27 hits leeches Void Debuffs in the order of Volatile -> Weaken -> Suppression. 
Scoring a hit against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs, or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly leeches said debuffs for Void Leech Mode.

Void Leech Mode:
Scoring a hit charges 1.3% Energy (76 hits).  Hits against Void-Debuffed Enemies charge 16.7% Energy (6 hits). 
Scoring a kill against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly charges Void Leech Mode.
Leeched Void Debuffs persist through stow. Void Leech Mode cannot be charged by self-applied debuffs.

Once charged, hold [Reload] to activate Void Leech for 15 [10] seconds.
Hits will inflict the Void Debuffs that were leeched and grants 20% increased damage.

Receiving Void Buffs refills Magazine. Reactivating Devour through kills also refills the magazine.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Dead Messenger
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Multi-Element Wave Frame Grenade Launcher
[Reload] switches between between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.
Chosen element persists through stow and death. Defaults to Void Element.

Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon inflicting or receiving an Elemental Effect that matches the currently selected Element.

Projectiles create 3 elemental waves in an arc upon collision with the ground.
Elemental Waves can [can't] deal overlapping damage and are longer than regular Wave Frames, travelling 22 meters instead of 15 meters.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Turnabout trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Divinity
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Trace Rifle
Intrinsic Overload Breaker. 
Deals half the damage of a regular Trace Rifle.

Fires a continuous beam that deals 15.3 [7.5] Arc Damage with a 1.34x Precision Multiplier at 900RPM.

Scoring 14 [5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each weakens, increasing damage taken by 15% [15%], and inflicting censured, creating a Precision Cage for 1.25 seconds. 
Shots that hit the Precision Cage are converted into into Precision Hits, but do not count as Weakspot Hits.
Weapons that cannot deal Precision Damage, such as Rocket Launchers and Fusion Rifles do not benefit from Precision Hits.
Divinity's weaken increases Divinity Damage by 30%.

 Enemies that remain in the Precision Field for 3.75 seconds suffer from Penance, receiving 1060 [520] damage. 
Penance's timer is increased to 4 seconds after the initial strike.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Edge of Action
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Void Adaptive Glaive

After scoring 6 Hits, either through Projectile or Melee Damage:
Hold [Reload] to switch fire mode, fully consuming Weapon Energy to prepare a Gumdrop Protective Shield for the next shot, refilling the magazine and granting +1 Ammo.

Protective Shield:
Lasts 20 seconds and has 2,400 Construct HP with 85% Damage Resist against non-Boss Combatants, and 15% Damage Resist against Bosses.
Protective Shield blocks incoming and outgoing projectiles, preventing damage from the outside.
While in the Protective Shield: Grants a 45 HP Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds at a rate of once per second and Stat Boost for 10 seconds.
Stat Boost | +? Handling, +? Reload Speed, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage. Buff duration is refreshed while inside. 
Helm of Saint-14 confers its defensive bonuses to the Protective Shield.

Kills collapse enemies into Transmutation Spheres with 30 Ammo. Spheres can remain on the ground for up to 30 seconds.

Damage is unaffected by the Ammo Remaining.

Grants 80% [50%] Damage Resist and prevents knockback while guarding. Combatants inside the draining field are disoriented.
Ammo Drains at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.25 seconds. The last remaining 3 Ammo drain at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.5 seconds until 1 Ammo is left.

Guarding while at 1 Ammo inflicts Transfiguration, dealing increasingly higher self-damage every 0.7 seconds until no longer Guarding or death.
